name: Hotel Greif „Straudi“
beschreibung: Hotel Greif 'Straudi' is situated in the alpine hub of Landeck in western Tyrol, encircled by breathtaking mountain scenery. The location grants direct access to scenic hiking paths in summer and premier ski resorts such as Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis and Venet in winter. Hotel amenities include an inviting restaurant serving Tyrolean cuisine, a wellness area with sauna, an outdoor dining garden, and dedicated ski and bike storage.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Greif 'Straudi' in Landeck provides modern guest rooms, authentic Tyrolean dining, a wellness sauna area, a garden, and direct access to regional trails and ski resorts.
